summary: Read a list of integers whose length is from 1 to 50000, plus two bounds called left and right. Both bounds and every list entry lie in 0 through 109, and left is no greater than right. Look at every contiguous fragment that contains at least one entry. A fragment qualifies when its biggest entry is no smaller than left while also staying no larger than right. Count the qualifying fragments and write the count.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
